network.shared: A shared responding IP is an observation node, not a physical device position. Inspect RTT in each individual trace.
network.gapHelp: * means no hop response, not a proven failure location. Each gap belongs to its own path.
network.unconfirmed: Destination reply not confirmed as reachable
omittedNotice: Collection limits omitted {interfaces} lower-priority interfaces and {evidence} evidence rows. This NIC and connection evidence view is partial.
observerNotConfigured: No observer is configured for this host, so host-based path diagnostics cannot be requested.
rateLimited: Diagnostic requests are too frequent. Each host allows one request per minute.
targetDenied: This destination is no longer on the server diagnostic allowlist. Refresh and select a configured destination.
inventoryWarning: Some host inventory or service health is unavailable. NIC, TCP probe and diagnostic evidence from individual observers remains separate.
probeNotice: Arrows are TCP connect observations from the source host to a configured service port. Success proves only this direction and port, never the reverse. Failure does not prove a whole-host outage. Missing or stale samples are unknown.
title: Infrastructure topology
description: Controller-centered workspace for measured host flows and LLDP switches/ports.
denied: Your current administrator authority cannot read these observations.
unavailable: Observations could not be refreshed. Retained data is not current.
noNics: No NIC observation is available. Reachability alone does not establish NIC links.
counterHelp: Totals are this boot's interface counters. Restart, reset, first sample and stale observations have unknown rates.
traceNotice: Run traceroute from the selected host to one configured IP. * means a hop did not respond, not a proven fault location. Reverse/inbound paths are not measured.
conflict: This host already has an active diagnostic. Refresh to inspect it.
traceUnavailable: The diagnostic submission outcome is unknown. Refresh before submitting again.
noTraces: No diagnostic history for this host.
error.traceroute_missing: traceroute is not installed on this host.
error.local_target_denied: The observer's local allowlist does not permit this destination.
error.route_unavailable: The host's outbound NIC and next hop could not be determined.
workspace.title: Physical network observations
workspace.coreHelp: Controllers anchor the layout; they are not inferred transit points.
workspace.scale: Width/brightness use a fixed logarithmic scale. Display size saturates at {maximum}; values remain exact.
workspace.navigation: Drag to pan; pinch to zoom. Focus the canvas: arrows pan, +/− zoom, 0 fits all. Select nodes/edges in the evidence list too.
workspace.noEdges: No connection evidence in these layers. A complete mesh is never inferred.
workspace.select: Select a node or evidence edge.
workspace.retained: Retained observations: current quantities/status are not verified.
workspace.flowNotice: Measured Linux skb packets/bytes may differ from wire packets due to offloading. Sender observations are preferred; sender and receiver are never summed.
workspace.physicalNotice: Physical links require LLDP evidence. Unresolved ports/missing switch counters remain unknown, never filled with host NIC rates.
workspace.snmpNotice: SNMP IF-MIB RX/TX at this port only; never summed with remote endpoints or host skb flows.
workspace.routeNotice: Reported destination/gateway route evidence, not a physical cable or measured packet traversal.
workspace.portUnknown: Switch-port counters are unknown; host NIC quantities are not substitutes.
workspace.flowCoverage: Packet collector measured on {measured}/{total} hosts · no unevidenced edges
workspace.fabricState.unconfigured: SNMP unconfigured · LLDP may still be observed
workspace.fabricError.snmp_identity_mism: Switch chassis differs from approved identity
workspace.fabricError.snmp_duplicate_sam: Duplicate switch sample · no new window
workspace.lldpDiagnostic: Raw LLDP advertisements. Bond, bridge, virtual or unclassified interface records never establish physical cables.
workspace.states: Zero means measured zero. Neutral dashes mean unknown quantity; stale, first sample, reset, collector error and unsupported remain distinct in the inspector. Short dashes show port membership, long dashes TCP, dotted paths route/trace evidence.
workspace.flowUnavailableCoverage: Packet collector unsupported {unsupported} · errors {errors} · no observation {unknown}
